name: nuclear-hexagram-computer-edge
description: Edge case: all-yin signals [0,0,0,0,0,0] → hoQue=2 (Thuần Khôn). All-changing-yang haos (LAO_DUONG) flip to yin → bienQue=2 (Thuần Khôn). Tests minimum-value boundary: inner nuclear structure and full transformation both yield pure yin hexagram.
notes: Signals [0,0,0,0,0,0]: hoSignals=[0,0,0,0,0,0] (indices 1-4) → Kun lower + Kun upper → hexagram 2. All LAO_DUONG haos (binary=1, changing): flipped to 0 → transformed=[0,0,0,0,0,0] → hexagram 2. Both are the minimum-signal (all-yin) boundary case.
